title: Chunin Exam
body:
Syntax: exam

Description: Enters the Forest of Death to attempt the Chunin Exam, required to advance from Genin to Chunin. Requires at least level 15 and 25 completed missions.

On entry, you receive either a Heaven Scroll (VNUM 20800) or an Earth Scroll (VNUM 20801). Defeat animals and rival ninja to find the other scroll. Once you have both, reach the central tower (VNUM 357) and ASK PROCTOR EXAM (or SUBMIT SCROLLS). The proctor consumes both scrolls and sends you to the final chamber (VNUM 670). The Third Hokage gives a speech about Heaven and Earth, then asks if you are ready for 1v1 combat. Type YES to summon a stronger, different-class copy of your character. The mob waits peacefully until you ATTACK it or target it with a jutsu. Type NO to postpone the fight, or READY to hear the speech again. Defeat your shadow to become Chunin and earn a headband; the rank promotion is announced globally. Your answer is saved across reconnects and reboots. Older Hell Scrolls still count as Earth Scrolls.

Leaving with LEAVE CONFIRM or dying fails the exam and forfeits the attempt; start a new attempt with EXAM.

Date: 2026-11-03
